Local control of Tuya and white-label devices on Homey Pro, without the Tuya cloud for Zigbee.
This branch is `stable-v5`: Reliability line: receives fixes from master after a soak period; fewer moving parts.

**Full documentation: https://dlnraja.github.io/com.tuya.zigbee/docs/** (searchable device list, FAQ, request guide, architecture, knowledge base).

## Install

| Channel | Link | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| Test | [https://homey.app/a/com.dlnraja.tuya.zigbee.stable/test/](https://homey.app/a/com.dlnraja.tuya.zigbee.stable/test/) | Every new version first; fixes arrive here days earlier |

Use only one of the three apps for a given device. Versions go to **Test** first (no Live release yet).
Release notes: [changelog](https://dlnraja.github.io/com.tuya.zigbee/docs/changelog.html) · [GitHub releases](https://github.com/dlnraja/com.tuya.zigbee/releases).

## Report a problem or request a device

**GitHub issues are the way to report:** [open an issue](https://github.com/dlnraja/com.tuya.zigbee/issues/new/choose). Please include:

1. the **manufacturer name** (`_TZE200_…`, `_TZ3000_…`) and the **model** (`TS0601`, `TS011F`…) from Homey Developer Tools → Zigbee;
2. the **Zigbee interview** (Developer Tools → the device → Interview), waking battery devices with their button;
3. a **diagnostic report** code from this app (Apps → this app → Send diagnostic report);
4. what the device is and what goes wrong.

Do not post local keys, tokens or other personal data. Details: [device request guide](https://dlnraja.github.io/com.tuya.zigbee/docs/request-device.html).

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | First thing to try |
|---|---|
| Pairs as unknown / generic / wrong class | Check the [device list](https://dlnraja.github.io/com.tuya.zigbee/docs/devices.html); update (Test channel), remove and re-pair |
| Button does nothing | Use the device's own trigger card; check scene vs dimmer mode ([FAQ](https://dlnraja.github.io/com.tuya.zigbee/docs/faq.html#scene-mode-vs-dimmer-mode)) |
| Clock or settings not applied on a battery device | Wake it with its button; writes wait for the next wake-up |
| Battery empty or stuck | Wait for the first report; some devices only send "battery low" |
| Wi-Fi device offline / one socket only | See the Wi-Fi section of the [FAQ](https://dlnraja.github.io/com.tuya.zigbee/docs/faq.html#wi-fi-local-devices) |
| Flow card unknown | Re-select the card in the Flow and save |

All answers: **[FAQ](https://dlnraja.github.io/com.tuya.zigbee/docs/faq.html)**.

## The three apps

- **Universal Tuya** (`master`): Main app: newest drivers and features. Ships to the Test channel first, then Live. [Code](https://github.com/dlnraja/com.tuya.zigbee/tree/master)
- **Zigbee Bastien** (`bastien-home`): Dedicated build for one community installation; gets master fixes after they are proven. [Code](https://github.com/dlnraja/com.tuya.zigbee/tree/bastien-home)
